item.title: Moonshot AI's Kimi K2.5 Narrows US-China AI Development Gap
item.description: Moonshot AI’s newest release, Kimi K2.5, has significantly narrowed the artificial intelligence model development gap between the United States and China. Third-party evaluations indicate this brings the two nations closer than ever in AI capabilities.

item.title: Soft Humanoid Robot GrowHR Unveiled by SUST Researchers
item.description: Researchers at the Southern University of Science and Technology (SUST) in Shenzhen have unveiled a soft humanoid robot that can change its size and move in various ways. The robot, named GrowHR, can squeeze through spaces, walk on water, and even fly. Credit: Liu et al., Sci. Adv. 12, eaea2831 This outstanding flexibility comes from a system the team developed, also called GrowHR. item.title: China's Cloud Giants Quickly Embrace Autonomous Moltbot AI Agent
item.description: China's artificial intelligence hyperscalers have swiftly added cloud support for Moltbot, an open-source AI agent seeing a global surge in popularity. Previously known as Clawdbot, Moltbot is billed as an "AI that actually does things" due to its ability to autonomously execute tasks without step-by-step user instructions.

item.title: AI Animated Film Festival Nominees to Screen in U.S. Theatres
item.description: Nominees from the Frame Forward Animated AI Film Festival will be shown in U.S. theatres throughout Feb. 2026. This marks a significant development for AI animation, with a public vote to select the winner.

item.title: China Humanoid Robot Sales Forecast Doubles Amid Falling Production Costs
item.description: Morgan Stanley has significantly revised its forecast for China's humanoid robot sales, now expecting a 133% increase to 28,000 units this year. The US investment bank previously projected sales of 14,000 units.

item.title: Indonesia Reinstates Grok Services After X Corp Compliance Pledge
item.description: Indonesia has permitted Elon Musk’s Grok chatbot to resume services, lifting a ban related to sexualised images on the application. The decision follows a commitment from X Corp to enhance compliance with Indonesian regulations. Credit: GROK Indonesia had suspended Grok's operations three weeks ago, citing potential risks from artificial intelligence-generated pornographic content. item.title: Hong Kong Sports App Identifies Bot Bookers, Prompts Calls for Stronger Touting Rules
item.description: Hong Kong authorities have detected robot-operated accounts booking public indoor sports venues on the SmartPLAY app. This discovery occurred just a week after a new anti-touting policy took effect, prompting experts to call for stronger measures against scalping.

item.title: Crawling Robotic Hand Boosts Object Handling, Access
item.description: Scientists have developed a detachable robotic hand capable of crawling and grasping objects, a design that could enhance capabilities in industrial, service, and exploratory robotics. This innovation enables tasks such as retrieving objects beyond normal reach and performing multi-object handling.

item.title: SpaceX Acquires xAI in Record Deal, Unifying Musk’s AI and Space Ventures
item.description: SpaceX has acquired artificial-intelligence startup xAI in a record-setting deal, announced by Chairman Elon Musk. This move unifies Mr Musk’s artificial intelligence and space ambitions, combining the rocket-and-satellite company with the maker of the Grok chatbot.
